title: The 4 Best Luggage for International Travel
h1: The 4 Best Luggage for International Travel
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for luggage for international travel, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at luggage for international travel using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Travelpro Platinum Elite 29-Inch Checked Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 29-inch expandable softside shell, 8 MagnaTrac spinner wheels, Tip-resistant tapered expansion, up to 2 inches more capacity.
strengths: 8-wheel design tracks straighter through crowded international terminals than 4-wheel competitors
Expansion panel adds real packing room for the return trip's souvenirs
Lifetime warranty covers common carrier damage, useful for bags that see rough international handling
Fold-out suiter keeps business attire wrinkle-resistant on multi-city trips
limitations: Softside shell offers less rain protection than a hardside competitor
29-inch size exceeds some international carriers' checked weight-friendly proportions when packed full
features: Tip-resistant tapered expansion, up to 2 inches more capacity

products.name: Briggs & Riley Baseline 28-Inch Large Expandable Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 28-inch expandable softside shell, Four double-swivel spinner wheels, One-touch compression system.
strengths: Compression system flattens contents without zippers straining under an overpacked bag
Lifetime guarantee covers airline damage indefinitely, the strongest warranty in this list
Double-swivel wheels roll smoother than single-caster wheels over uneven cobblestone and tile common abroad
limitations: Feels heavy once fully packed, closer to checked weight limits than lighter competitors
Understated styling, no bright colorways for easy carousel identification
features: Simple As That lifetime guarantee, no receipt needed

products.name: Samsonite Freeform 24-Inch Medium Hardside Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-inch expandable polypropylene hardshell, Dual 360-degree spinner wheels, TSA-approved combination lock.
strengths: Hardshell handles wet climates and rough tarmac loading better than softside at this price
8.5-pound empty weight leaves more of the checked weight limit for actual belongings
limitations: Polypropylene shell scratches and shows scuffs more visibly than textured competitors
Single-caster style wheel housing wears faster than the double-swivel wheels on premium bags
10-year warranty is limited, not the unconditional coverage of Briggs & Riley

products.name: Monos Carry-On Pro 22-Inch Hardside Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 22-inch polycarbonate hardshell, 36L capacity, Front tech compartment fits a 16-inch laptop, 360-degree spinner wheels.
strengths: Front laptop compartment gives quick access at security without opening the main compartment
36L capacity fits most international carry-on sizers, including tighter European limits
Highest owner rating in this list at 4.8 out of 5
limitations: 22-inch size is on the larger edge of some strict regional carry-on sizers
No expansion panel, capacity is fixed at 36L
features: Front tech compartment fits a 16-inch laptop

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
